## Finance Department
## C.No.13/SDEI/SKM/2015
30. The proposal for issue of BRO for an amount of Rs 270 crores to the.
SDEI department is accepted in the Finance Department. The department is
requested to work out detailed protocol for release of funds to the SEIMENS,
duly ensuring that release of funds is directly indexed to performance.
Accordingly, the department is requested to work out protocol for operation of
funds.
Principal Finance Secretary
